rules.title: A group does not stand still inside the enemy mezzer's reach before the fight
The two groups' healers and casters keep their distance
Casters cast from the edge of their range
A group's healers do not stand together
rules.measured: closer than 800 units 16% of the time

rules.title: A fighter running at the healers is stopped
A shield fighter told to stay beside its healer stays
rules.measured: an attack target 2% of the time it was told to stay

rules.title: Nobody stops to buff once the fight has started
rules.measured: 1.1 a match; most: cleric-enhance StrengthConstitutionBuff 0.3, cleric-enhance DexterityQuicknessBuff 0.2, cleric-enhance AcuityBuff 0.2, cleric-rejuv ConstitutionBuff 0.2

rules.title: A healer does not call its pet in a fight
The Bard keeps its endurance song up without spending the fight on it
Keeping their distance does not stop the casters casting
rules.measured: casting 32%, walking 33%; least casting: sorcerer-mind 20%, runemaster-rune 28%, enchanter-light 31%

rules.title: Nobody dies within seconds of contact
rules.measured: first death at a median of 92 s; within 20 s in 1 of 12 matches; the earliest at 19 s
